mapper.select: /* * idx_rta_match_synergy_pending (replay_id ASC) WHERE synergy_applied_at IS NULL * 을 타도록 설계된 쿼리. 인덱스 생성 후 ANALYZE 실행 필수. * NULL 행이 0건이면 인덱스(빈 트리)에서 즉시 반환 — Seq Scan 불필요. * ANALYZE 후에도 Parallel Seq Scan 이 계속된다면 아래 힌트 주석 해제. */ -- SET LOCAL enable_seqscan = OFF; SELECT m.replay_id FROM public.rta_match m WHERE m.synergy_applied_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.replay_id LIMIT #{batchSize}
SELECT m.replay_id AS rid, TRIM(BOTH FROM m.winner_wizard_id::text) AS winner_wizard_id, m.played_at AS date_add, m.season_id FROM public.rta_match m WHERE m.replay_id = #{rid}

SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(BOTH FROM u.wizard_id::text) AS wizard_id, u.unit_master_id AS unit_master_id FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u WHERE u.replay_id = #{rid} AND u.is_banned = false ORDER BY wizard_id, unit_master_id
SELECT TRIM(BOTH FROM mp.wizard_id::text) AS wizard_id, CAST(mp.rating_id AS INTEGER) AS rating_id FROM public.rta_match_participant mp WHERE mp.replay_id = #{rid}
SELECT mp.replay_id AS rid, TRIM(BOTH FROM mp.wizard_id::text) AS wizard_id, CAST(mp.rating_id AS INTEGER) AS rating_id FROM public.rta_match_participant mp WHERE mp.replay_id = ANY(#{rids})
SELECT m.replay_id AS rid, TRIM(BOTH FROM m.winner_wizard_id::text) AS winner_wizard_id, m.played_at AS date_add, m.season_id FROM public.rta_match m WHERE m.replay_id = ANY(#{rids})

SELECT DISTINCT u.replay_id AS rid, TRIM(BOTH FROM u.wizard_id::text) AS wizard_id, u.unit_master_id AS unit_master_id FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u WHERE u.replay_id = ANY(#{rids}) AND COALESCE(u.is_banned, false) = false

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_synergy_solo (season_id, rating_id, combo_unit_key, match_cnt, win_cnt, ban_cnt) VALUES
(#{r.seasonId}, #{r.ratingId}, #{r.comboKey}, #{r.matchDelta}, #{r.winDelta}, 0)
ON CONFLICT (season_id, rating_id, combo_unit_key) DO UPDATE SET match_cnt = public.rta_agg_synergy_solo.match_cnt + EXCLUDED.match_cnt, win_cnt = public.rta_agg_synergy_solo.win_cnt + EXCLUDED.win_cnt, ban_cnt = public.rta_agg_synergy_solo.ban_cnt

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_synergy_duo (season_id, rating_id, combo_unit_key, match_cnt, win_cnt) VALUES
(#{r.seasonId}, #{r.ratingId}, #{r.comboKey}, #{r.matchDelta}, #{r.winDelta})
ON CONFLICT (season_id, rating_id, combo_unit_key) DO UPDATE SET match_cnt = public.rta_agg_synergy_duo.match_cnt + EXCLUDED.match_cnt, win_cnt = public.rta_agg_synergy_duo.win_cnt + EXCLUDED.win_cnt

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_synergy_trio (season_id, rating_id, combo_unit_key, match_cnt, win_cnt) VALUES
(#{r.seasonId}, #{r.ratingId}, #{r.comboKey}, #{r.matchDelta}, #{r.winDelta})
ON CONFLICT (season_id, rating_id, combo_unit_key) DO UPDATE SET match_cnt = public.rta_agg_synergy_trio.match_cnt + EXCLUDED.match_cnt, win_cnt = public.rta_agg_synergy_trio.win_cnt + EXCLUDED.win_cnt

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_counter_matchup ( season_id, rating_id, subject_unit_id, opponent_combo_key, opponent_combo_size, win_cnt, lose_cnt ) VALUES
(#{r.seasonId}, #{r.ratingId}, #{r.subjectUnitId}, #{r.opponentComboKey}, #{r.opponentComboSize}::smallint, #{r.winDelta}::bigint, #{r.loseDelta}::bigint)
ON CONFLICT (season_id, rating_id, subject_unit_id, opponent_combo_key) DO UPDATE SET win_cnt = public.rta_agg_counter_matchup.win_cnt + EXCLUDED.win_cnt, lose_cnt = public.rta_agg_counter_matchup.lose_cnt + EXCLUDED.lose_cnt, opponent_combo_size = EXCLUDED.opponent_combo_size

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_counter_matchup ( season_id, rating_id, subject_unit_id, opponent_combo_key, opponent_combo_size, win_cnt, lose_cnt ) SELECT s.season_id, s.rating_id, s.subject_unit_id, s.opponent_combo_key, MAX(s.opponent_combo_size)::smallint AS opponent_combo_size, SUM(s.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt, SUM(s.lose_cnt)::bigint AS lose_cnt FROM public.staging_matchup_agg s GROUP BY s.season_id, s.rating_id, s.subject_unit_id, s.opponent_combo_key ON CONFLICT (season_id, rating_id, subject_unit_id, opponent_combo_key) DO UPDATE SET win_cnt = public.rta_agg_counter_matchup.win_cnt + EXCLUDED.win_cnt, lose_cnt = public.rta_agg_counter_matchup.lose_cnt + EXCLUDED.lose_cnt, opponent_combo_size = EXCLUDED.opponent_combo_size

UPDATE public.rta_match SET synergy_applied_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, synergy_apply_result = 'F' WHERE replay_id = #{rid}
mapper.insert: WITH , , win_agg AS ( SELECT u.wizard_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN u.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS win_count FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN pool_ranked p ON p.wizard_id = u.wizard_id WHERE u.season_id = #{seasonId} AND u.ladder_score > 0 GROUP BY u.wizard_id ) INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_summoner_ranking_snap ( season_id, rank_position, wizard_id, wizard_name, country, channel_uid, score, rating_id, max_season_score, match_count, win_count, computed_at ) SELECT #{seasonId}, p.rank_position, p.wizard_id, p.wizard_name, p.country, p.channel_uid, p.max_score AS score, p.rating_id, p.max_score::int AS max_season_score, COALESCE(wa.match_count, 0)::bigint AS match_count, COALESCE(wa.win_count, 0)::bigint AS win_count, now() FROM pool_ranked p LEFT JOIN win_agg wa ON wa.wizard_id = p.wizard_id ORDER BY p.rank_position
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (wizard_id) wizard_id, wizard_name, country_code AS country, channel_uid, ladder_score AS score, rating_id FROM public.rta_match_participant WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND ( wizard_id::text = #{query} OR wizard_name ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' ) ORDER BY wizard_id, ladder_score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT season_id AS "seasonId", season_code AS "seasonCode", season_no AS "seasonNo", league_type AS "leagueType", season_name AS "seasonName", start_at AS "startAt", end_at AS "endAt", is_active AS "isActive", sort_order AS "sortOrder", to_char((start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startYmdKst", to_char(((end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "lastInclusiveYmdKst", to_char((end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endExclusiveYmdKst" FROM rta_season ORDER BY sort_order ASC, season_no DESC, season_code ASC
SELECT season_id AS "seasonId", start_at AS "startAt", end_at AS "endAt", season_code AS "seasonCode" FROM rta_season WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE( ( SELECT season_id FROM rta_season WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY sort_order ASC, season_no DESC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT season_id FROM rta_season ORDER BY season_no DESC, season_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) )

SELECT rg.rating_id AS "ratingId", rg.grade_name AS "gradeName", rg.grade_abbr AS "gradeAbbr", rg.icon_url AS "iconUrl", rg.tier_sort AS "tierSort", rgs.min_win_points AS "minWinPoints", rgs.rank_rule AS "rankRule" FROM public.rta_rating_grade rg LEFT JOIN public.rta_rating_grade_season rgs ON rgs.rating_id = rg.rating_id AND rgs.season_id = #{seasonId} WHERE rg.grade_slot IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rg.tier_sort NULLS LAST, rg.rating_id

WITH mx AS ( SELECT MAX(s.snapshot_at) AS ts FROM public.rta_snapshot_rank_cut s WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} ) SELECT s.snapshot_at AS "snapshotAt", s.rating_id AS "ratingId", rg.grade_name AS "gradeName", rg.grade_abbr AS "gradeAbbr", s.cutoff_score AS "cutoffScore" FROM public.rta_snapshot_rank_cut s INNER JOIN public.rta_rating_grade rg ON rg.rating_id = s.rating_id INNER JOIN public.rta_rating_grade_season rgs ON rgs.rating_id = s.rating_id AND rgs.season_id = #{seasonId} CROSS JOIN mx WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND mx.ts IS NOT NULL AND s.snapshot_at = mx.ts AND rgs.min_win_points IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rg.tier_sort NULLS LAST, s.rating_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.rta_rank_cutoff_anchor_snap (snapshot_at, sort_order, anchor_key, grade_slot, cutoff_score) WITH , rank_window AS ( SELECT (MAX(r.date_add)::date - INTERVAL '120 days')::date AS min_date FROM rta_match_in_season r ), rta_match_in_window AS ( SELECT r.rid, r.date_add, r.winner_wizard_id, r.battle_type FROM rta_match_in_season r INNER JOIN rank_window w ON r.date_add::date >= w.min_date ), anchors AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, '3h', INTERVAL '3 hours'), (2, '6h', INTERVAL '6 hours'), (3, '12h', INTERVAL '12 hours'), (4, '3d', INTERVAL '3 days'), (5, '7d', INTERVAL '7 days') ) AS v(sort_order, anchor_key, iv) ), base AS ( SELECT r.date_add, u.ladder_score AS score_val, ( CASE WHEN u.rating_id >= 5000 THEN 60 WHEN u.rating_id >= 4000 THEN 50 WHEN u.rating_id >= 3500 THEN 40 WHEN u.rating_id >= 3000 THEN 30 WHEN u.rating_id >= 2000 THEN 20 ELSE 10 END + CASE WHEN (u.rating_id % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (u.rating_id % 10) ELSE 2 END ) AS tier_sort_order, ( CASE WHEN u.rating_id >= 5000 THEN 'L' WHEN u.rating_id >= 4000 THEN 'G' WHEN u.rating_id >= 3500 THEN 'P' WHEN u.rating_id >= 3000 THEN 'C' WHEN u.rating_id >= 2000 THEN 'F' ELSE 'Ch' END ) || CASE WHEN (u.rating_id % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (u.rating_id % 10)::text ELSE '2' END AS grade_slot FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_window r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE u.rating_id >= 1000 AND u.ladder_score > 0 ), tiers AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('G3', 53), ('G2', 52), ('G1', 51), ('P3', 43), ('P2', 42) ) AS tv(grade_slot, tier_sort_order) ), , lower_bound AS ( SELECT a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, t.grade_slot, MAX(b.score_val)::bigint AS lower_max_score FROM anchors a CROSS JOIN tiers t LEFT JOIN base b ON b.tier_sort_order < t.tier_sort_order AND b.date_add >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - a.iv AND b.date_add <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP GROUP BY a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, a.iv, t.grade_slot, t.tier_sort_order ) SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, t.grade_slot, GREATEST( COALESCE(tof.min_pts, 0)::bigint, COALESCE(lb.lower_max_score + 1, 0)::bigint ) AS cutoff_score FROM anchors a CROSS JOIN tiers t LEFT JOIN tier_official tof ON tof.grade_slot = t.grade_slot LEFT JOIN lower_bound lb ON lb.sort_order = a.sort_order AND lb.anchor_key = a.anchor_key AND lb.grade_slot = t.grade_slot

INSERT INTO public.rta_snapshot_rank_cut (season_id, snapshot_at, rating_id, cutoff_score) SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.season_id, rg.rating_id) s.season_id, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, rg.rating_id, COALESCE(( SELECT MIN(u.ladder_score) FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN public.rta_match m ON m.replay_id = u.replay_id WHERE m.played_at >= s.start_at AND m.played_at < s.end_at AND u.rating_id = rg.rating_id AND u.ladder_score > 0 ), rgs.min_win_points, 0)::bigint FROM public.rta_season s INNER JOIN public.rta_rating_grade rg ON rg.grade_slot IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN public.rta_rating_grade_season rgs ON rgs.season_id = s.season_id AND rgs.rating_id = rg.rating_id ORDER BY s.season_id, rg.rating_id

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_season_rating_match_total (season_id, rating_id, total_matches, computed_at) SELECT m.season_id, p.rating_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.replay_id)::bigint AS total_matches, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM public.rta_match_participant p INNER JOIN public.rta_match m ON m.replay_id = p.replay_id WHERE p.rating_id IS NOT NULL AND p.rating_id > 0 GROUP BY m.season_id, p.rating_id ON CONFLICT (season_id, rating_id) DO UPDATE SET total_matches = EXCLUDED.total_matches, computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.rta_snapshot_rank_cut s WHERE s.snapshot_at = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_at) FROM public.rta_snapshot_rank_cut)

SELECT x.opponent_combo_key AS "opponentComboKey", x.opponent_combo_size AS "opponentComboSize", x.win_cnt AS "winCnt", x.lose_cnt AS "loseCnt", CASE WHEN (x.win_cnt + x.lose_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * x.win_cnt::numeric / (x.win_cnt + x.lose_cnt)::numeric, 2) ELSE NULL END AS "winRate", ( SELECT string_agg(m.kr_name, ' + ' ORDER BY z.ord) FROM unnest(string_to_array(x.opponent_combo_key, ',')) WITH ORDINALITY AS z(id, ord) LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM z.id), '') ) AS "opponentLabel" FROM ( SELECT c.opponent_combo_key, MAX(c.opponent_combo_size)::smallint AS opponent_combo_size, SUM(c.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt, SUM(c.lose_cnt)::bigint AS lose_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_counter_matchup c WHERE c.season_id = #{seasonId} AND c.subject_unit_id = #{monsterId} GROUP BY c.opponent_combo_key ) x ORDER BY (x.win_cnt + x.lose_cnt) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 40
mapper.update: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rta_agg_counter_matchup_season_subject ON public.rta_agg_counter_matchup (season_id, subject_unit_id)
